title: Evaluating 3D Reconstruction: A Side-by-Side Comparison of NeRF and Gaussian Splatting in Indoor and Outdoor Environments
abstract: This study presents a comparative evaluation of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for 3D reconstruction in indoor and outdoor environments. Both algorithms were assessed on consistent datasets captured with a stabilized full-frame camera setup, using reconstruction noise, detail preservation, and processing time as key evaluation criteria. The results reveal that while both approaches generate high-fidelity reconstructions, 3DGS outperforms NeRF in computational efficiency and noise reduction, offering practical guidance for selecting a reconstruction pipeline depending on the scene type and application requirements.
